mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.subject, p.total_score, p.pass_score, p.duration_minutes, p.status, p.creator_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS creator_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id = p.id) AS question_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_paper (title, subject, total_score, pass_score, duration_minutes, status, creator_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{subject}, #{totalScore}, #{passScore}, #{durationMinutes}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_paper p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.subject, p.total_score, p.pass_score, p.duration_minutes, p.status, p.creator_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS creator_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id = p.id) AS question_count, r.id AS record_id, r.status AS record_status, r.score AS record_score FROM exam_paper p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN exam_record r ON r.paper_id = p.id AND r.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_paper SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
